description: This Java class 'ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory' serves as a factory for creating JMS connections based on a Connection object, primarily for AMQP messaging using Qpid JMS. It handles connection URI building, SSL context setup, and manages failover configurations.

classes.name: ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory
classes.description: A thread-unsafe factory class responsible for creating JMS connections from specified Connection objects, with support for SSL, failover, and URI configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory with provided AMQP configuration.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a JMS connection based on the provided Connection, setting SSL context if needed, and attaching an exception listener.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a JNDI initial context for JMS connection lookup, configured with connection URI.

methods.name: buildAmqpConnectionUriFromConnection
methods.description: Builds a complete AMQP connection URI string from a Connection object and optional AMQP configuration, including handling security, failover, and parameters.
